I farm this maize plot in the North West, and the rains here can be tough on the soil, so I must put fertilizer — without it the maize will not give good yield. I will use the NPK and a little urea like most of us do, and I also spread some manure from my animals because it helps the soil hold water. I cannot afford the hybrid seed from the agro-dealer this year, so I will plant from my own seed like my father did, and I will call on my sons and some hired hands during weeding and harvest.
